meta.name: tps-review-deep
meta.description: tps review --deep — same filesystem access as local review, plus network for LLM-assisted review. Linux note: Landlock cannot express deny-within-allow, so a deny nested inside an allowed parent makes nono refuse to start (it will not silently weaken the deny) — keep every deny at or above the allow roots. Matters for the exe.dev profiles (ops-mxf9). Never grant the state root: ~/.tps/secrets and ~/.tps/identity are siblings of the mailbox and agent state, so a grant or deny at ~/.tps level takes the mailbox and agent state with it.
